title: SR 8 over Yellow River | 1997 rehabilitation design
source_note: Primary: INDOT B-23076, 1997 rehabilitation and shop drawings (28-page existing-plans bundle). Later 2026 B-43353 overlay is reference only.
assumptions: Exterior visualization reconstruction, not an as-built survey, load rating or validated FEM mesh.
No internal reinforcement, prestressing strands, embedded studs, weld beads or fabrication holes. Material colors are visualization choices.
Source pages mix historical removals and proposed work. Only the explicitly named design state is modeled; the separately stored later references do not alter that state.
Buried foundations are hidden by default. Unknown driven pile lengths, terrain and approach-road terminal systems are omitted.
Bearing contact checks verify constructed geometric attachment only; they do not establish surveyed bearing elevations or fabrication tolerances.
1997 metric dimensions control. W840x193 root fillets, exact diaphragm rows, retained fixed shoes and central pier dimensions are simplified. No 2026 overlay thickness is added.

detail_coverage.detail: 1997 metric spans and seven steel lines; 49-degree skew and 152.4 m crest profile. The 3 mm sum discrepancy between rounded span callouts and the total framing dimension is retained in the source ledger.
Fourteen field-splice envelopes, 42 bearings and transverse diaphragm envelopes. Some diaphragm stations and old shoes remain approximate.
End/pile-bent envelopes from the 1997 sheets; central retained piers and unverified seat levels from general elevation only.
Concrete rails and both approaches. Wing flare, transition barriers, drain penetrations and steel guardrail terminals are not reconstructed.
Exact central pier/footing geometry, complete drainage, transition hardware and all retained-steel connection details need further source reconciliation.
